The Bombay High Court will hear actor Imran Khan's petition against a 'leave India notice' on October 26. The directive was issued following Khan's participation in a Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) protest in Mumbai.

The case has drawn political attention. Actor Aamir Khan met Maharashtra Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray amid the legal proceedings, while Lok Janshakti Party leader Chirag Paswan endorsed the notice and criticised Khan's involvement in the demonstration.
